faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Stash

q1.question: What is Stash?
q1.answer: Stash is a CRM system for small service businesses like salons, barbershops, clinics, and shops. It helps you manage customers, bookings, inventory, and payments in one place.

q2.question: Who is Stash for?
q2.answer: Stash is designed for beauty salons, barbershops, wellness clinics, small retail shops, and any service-based business that needs to manage appointments and customer relationships.

q3.question: How do I get started?
q3.answer: Sign up for a free account, add your business details, create your services and products, and invite your staff. Your public booking page is generated automatically.

q4.question: Do my customers need an account to book?
q4.answer: No. Customers can book appointments through your public page without creating an account. They just need to provide their name and phone number.

q5.question: How does the client tab system work?
q5.answer: The client tab lets you track what each customer owes. Record purchases and services, accept payments, and always see the current balance for each client.

q6.question: Can I add multiple employees?
q6.answer: Yes. The free plan includes 1 employee. The Pro plan supports unlimited employees, each with their own schedule and booking page.

q7.question: Where is my data stored?
q7.answer: Your data is stored securely in the cloud with daily backups. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your information.

q8.question: Can I use Stash on my phone?
q8.answer: Yes. Stash works in any web browser on your phone, tablet, or computer. No app download needed.

q9.question: What languages are supported?
q9.answer: Stash is available in Russian and English. You can switch languages in your dashboard settings.

q10.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
q10.answer: You can cancel anytime from your account settings. Your data remains accessible for 30 days after cancellation.
